progression.narrative: The performance opens on Bb2 and dwells most on Eb in Naghmeh-e Maghlub. The line peaks at F4 (371.0 Hz) at 0:52.5. It closes on Ck4, not the tonic (F4 → Dk4 → Dk4 → Ck4 → Ck4 → Ck4).
